lead.headline: Nothing moved overnight: Tate is still questionable and 'good to go'; Barkley is out
lead.deck: Your lineup is still the projection lineup. London kicks off half an hour after tomorrow's edition, and the one check is Tate's name on Sunday's inactive list.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players, which is Friday's unchanged. Carnell Tate is questionable after two limited practices on the back he tightened up on Thursday. The comfort is second-hand: ESPN's Turron Davenport relays that Robert Saleh called it 'random tightness' and him 'fine' and 'good to go', and there is still no verbatim quote. Saquon Barkley is out for London and not on injured reserve. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. You lead 28–1 on George Pickens's 13-target Thursday; ESPN has it 133.5 to 122.3 and 56%, which with eight players each to come is close to even. Lawrence, Tuten and the Jaguars' defence play at 07:30 on Sunday, half an hour after tomorrow's edition; none has a designation, and Philadelphia now say Will Shipley is their primary back behind a line with three new starters. Two corrections to Friday: that Shipley line, and Ladd McConkey, who is questionable, not doubtful. Nothing needs doing today.
